findings.failure_path: Using text=True performs universal-newline conversion even with errors='surrogateescape'. A Git pathname containing carriage return is therefore changed to a different pathname before NUL splitting, matching, and receipt lookup. The same issue affects added_evidence_paths after its switch to -z, so classification and diagnostics can inspect or report the wrong name.
findings.smallest_fix: Capture stdout as bytes, split on b'\0', and decode each pathname with os.fsdecode. Add a regression distinguishing carriage-return and newline filenames.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: this enables unconditional approval for the packet server, but the frozen packet omits its handlers, digest-validation implementation, audit_codex, and the packet_read test dispatcher. Exact command arguments and tool names cannot establish that execution reads only frozen packet bytes or that invalid calls cannot produce an accepted verdict. The supplied observations remain claims about those omitted paths.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the packet-server handlers and validation, event audit, and relevant happy/negative test dispatch in the frozen review packet so the execution boundary and acceptance coverage can be traced.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: The shown preflight predicates and model/profile carry-over match the acceptance cases. Packet-read completion cannot be verified without the omitted dispatch implementation.
Private-home permissions and server-count checks are visible, but the newly auto-approved reader's implementation is absent.
Preflight refusals remain explicit. Text-mode subprocess decoding can corrupt evidence pathnames before classification.
Added assertions cover home isolation, malformed and duplicate rows, credential replacement, and continuation wording. Packet dispatch and raw-pathname edge coverage are not supplied.
The supplied preference fixture covers profile resolution and dotted provider names. Carriage-return filenames are not preserved by the new enumeration.
Package versions agree and configuration changes are run-scoped. The documented credential-replacement path requires reauthentication; reverting the package does not recover a discarded rotation.
The binder adds ordering diagnostics, but pathname normalization can identify the wrong evidence file.
The enabled-server invariant is inspectable. Safety and verdict integrity across the auto-approved tool boundary remain an evidence gap.
